chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a girl called Katy. Every day, Katy and her Dad would go to the park. Today, Katy wanted something special. She asked her Dad if they could go to the video store.
Katy's Dad said yes, so they went to the video store. When they arrived, Katy looked around and saw lots of delicious videos. She pointed to a video and said to her Dad, “Can I order this one?"
Her Dad said, “No, Katy, you shouldn't order anything without asking. You should always be polite and ask first."
Katy nodded and said, “I remember. Sorry, Dad.”
Katy's Dad smiled and said, “It's okay. You can order the video if you ask nicely.”
So, Katy asked and said, “May I please order the video?"
Her Dad said, “Yes, of course you can.”
Katy was so happy that she could order the video. This taught her an important lesson: always be polite and ask nicely before ordering anything.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a friendly little boy named Jake who often went to the park with his mum. One day, Jake saw a strange man standing near the park entrance. The man had a big piece of luggage in his hands. Jake thought the man looked pretty harmless so he decided to talk to him.
"Hello mister," said Jake. "Where are you going with your luggage?"
The man smiled. "Oh, I'm on a special adventure. I'm going to pinch something special," he said.
Jake was curious. "What are you going to pinch?"
The man winked. "You'll find out," he said.
The next day, Jake walked to the park again. He noticed the same man, but this time he had a bag full of special goodies. The man winked at Jake and said, "I have something special for you."
Jake reached out to grab the bag, but suddenly the man pinched him on the arm! It hurt, but it wasn't that bad. However, the man then grabbed Jake by the collar and dragged him away from the park.
He took Jake to a dark alley and said, "You were a bit too nosy, so now I'm going to pinch something from you!"
Jake was scared and began to cry. The man grabbed his wallet and ran. Jake was left alone in the dark alley, feeling hopeless

chapters.title: Once there was a big green…
p: Once there was a big green frog who wanted to go outside and have some fun. But first he had to step over a wet cable. He hopped carefully around it and looked at the trees in the sunshine. It was a beautiful day! He could see a pond nearby and he hopped towards it. When he got close, he jumped straight in! The cool water felt so nice on his skin and he splashed around happily. But then he heard a noise! Suddenly he jumped out and saw an animal running away. His heart raced and he looked all around. He was safe, but it was time to go back home. The frog stepped carefully over the wet cable and hopped away. He was so happy to have had such an exciting adventure!

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once, there was a little girl who loved to balance. She would practice every day and it was lots of fun. She wanted to be the most fancy person at balancing.
One day, the little girl heard about a balancing tournament. She knew that this was a chance to make her dream come true. She knew it would be difficult, but she was determined to try her best.
The little girl started practicing more. She made sure to balance on steeper hills, and it was very difficult.

On the day of the tournament, the little girl was nervous. She watched as fancy balancers tried to prove themselves. It was very exciting - but when it was her turn, she nearly fell over. She was so discouraged and wanted to give up.

But then the little girl remembered all the fun she had practicing. She forgot about being fancy and just enjoyed the challenge of balancing. She tried her best and was able to finish the course. Everyone cheered for her and she felt proud.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time there were two friends, Bob and Amy. They were both playing around in an elevator. They were very excited and kept pushing all the buttons.
Suddenly, the elevator started to move very fast! Amy and Bob were scared, but then Bob said, "Let's try to catch the buttons!"

They both tried to catch the buttons, but the elevator was going too fast. Amy said, "It's too hard to catch the buttons. What should we do?" Bob said, "Let's just make this elevator go the other way!"
So, Amy and Bob worked together and quickly grabbed the buttons. The elevator stopped and they were so happy. They ran out and started playing again.
"That was a fast ride!" said Bob. Amy said, "Yes, but don't do it again without a grown-up, ok?" Bob said, "Yes, ok." And they laughed together until the sun went down.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a harmless little mouse called Max. He wanted to build a house in the woods but he had no hammer. He asked the little birds in the trees if they had seen one but alas, they had not.

So Max decided to find a human to help him. He found a kind old lady who listened to his request. She had a hammer but she told Max that it didn't belong to him and insisted he take it back to her when he was done.

Max agreed and set off to build his house but as soon as he struck the woods with the hammer, something extraordinary happened! The trees and rocks started to move and create a house for Max! He was so delighted but he made sure to take the hammer back to the old lady.
Even though the hammer had worked its magic, the old lady still insisted Max take it back to her. Max thanked her for her kindness and promised he'd return it.
The old lady smiled and waved goodbye to Max, happy that her harmless little mouse had found a home and a way to stay safe in the woods.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a friendly rabbit called Jane. She was always happy and loved to play outside in her garden.

One day Jane was feeling bored so she decided to search for something fun to do. As she looked around she suddenly saw a trumpet under a nearby bush. With a big smile on her face, she picked it up, put it to her mouth and started playing.
But then a loud voice interrupted her music. It was her neighbour, Mrs Cat. She shouted at Jane and scowled, "Stop that racket! You'll wake up the whole neighbourhood!"
Jane was a bit scared of Mrs Cat so she quickly put down the trumpet. She tried to explain that she was just looking for something fun to do, but Mrs Cat wouldn't listen.
But then a miracle happened! Mrs Cat's face softened, and she smiled. "Come to my house," she said, "I'll teach you how to play the trumpet properly."
So Jane followed Mrs Cat back to her house and the two of them had lots of fun. Mrs Cat was very friendly, and before long she taught Jane some simple tunes.
From then on the two became very close friends. They played the trumpet together every day and it made Jane the happiest bunny in the world.

chapters.title: Alice and Lenny were in the…
p: Alice and Lenny were in the park when they heard splashing. They ran over to the pond and saw a mole swimming. It was having trouble swimming, so Lenny decided to dive in and help the mole.
Lenny: "Don't worry, little mole. I'll help you."
He quickly dove into the water and grabbed the mole. He pulled the troubled mole to safety. Alice laughed and gave Lenny a big hug.
Alice: "You're so brave, Lenny!"
Lenny smiled and looked at the mole.
Lenny: "Do you want to come and play with us?"
The mole shook its head and ran off through the grass. Alice and Lenny laughed and went back to their game.

chapters.title: Toby was having a hard day…
p: Toby was having a hard day. He had tried so hard to do tough things but they had all been too tough for him. He picked up a truck but it slipped out of his hands and dropped right onto the floor. Toby started to cry, so his mom came over to him and said,
"Don't worry, Toby! It's ok if you drop things. We all make mistakes."
Toby sniffled and nodded. Then his mom said,
"Let's go get our truck and try again. It won't be so tough, I promise."
So Toby followed his mom and they picked up their truck together. Toby gave it his best try, but this time he was able to hold onto it without it dropping. Toby smiled and his mom said,
"See, you can do tough things, Toby!"
Toby was proud of himself, and he was very relieved that he didn't have to drop the truck again.

chapters.title: Once upon a time two friends…
p: Once upon a time, two friends - John and Maya - went to the store. They were looking for a hat for John. Maya was so excited and said, "I know kind of hat John should get!"
John agreed and started to look around the store. He found a perfect hat - blue and kind with a cute bunny design. He tried it on and said to Maya, "It's perfect! I'm going to take it!"
Maya smiled and said, "I'm so glad you like it, John! It looks so good on you."
John said, "Thanks, Maya! You've been a really kind friend."
Together, they went to the cashier and John bought his new hat. From then on, whenever John and Maya walked together, John wore his new kind hat and they had lots of fun.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a fish who lived in the sea. He liked to swim and explore the wonderful corners of the ocean.

One day, on his travels, he stumbled upon a wealthy stamp collector. The collector was very surprised to see the fish, so he asked him what he was doing in this part of the ocean. “I like to swim and explore” the fish replied.

The wealthy stamp collector wasn't too happy about this. He said the fish was in danger of swimming away with a very precious stamp. The fish didn't understand and tried to move away, but the collector grabbed his tail.

The fish was so scared that he started to cry. But then, a friendly dolphin came along and saved him from the collector. She said she could help the fish to find a safe place to swim away and hide from the wealthy collector.
The fish was so happy to hear that. He thanked the friendly dolphin and swam away. From then on, he continued to explore the ocean, always staying away from the wealthy stamp collector.

chapters.title: Once there were two friends a…
p: Once there were two friends, a kitten and a puppy. The puppy and kitten loved to play together every day. One day, they decided they should get a treat.
The puppy wanted to get a rare cookie, but the kitten wanted to get ice cream. The puppy and kitten could not agree.
The puppy said, “I want the rare cookie!”
The kitten said, “No! I want ice cream!”
The puppy insisted on the rare cookie and the kitten insisted on ice cream. They argued and disagreed until they were too angry to talk to each other.
The puppy sadly walked away, never to see the kitten again. The kitten was left with no treat at all.

chapters.title: Freddy was walking in the park…
p: Freddy was walking in the park one day when he saw something huge lying on the grass. He cautiously approached it and realized it was a sausage! He decided to eat it and ran to get his friend Joy to help.
When Freddy found Joy, he shouted: "Look! I found this huge sausage, do you want to eat it?"
"Sure!" said Joy.
They both sat down and the sausage was huge, so they both worked together to eat it. They ate it slowly, making sure they shared it equally.
When they finished, they smiled and said: "That was delicious!".
They decided they had better not tell their parents about the huge sausage they'd eaten. They agreed it was going to be a secret between them.
The friends laughed and hugged each other as they walked off into the sunset.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a family who had a fridge. The fridge was full of delicious food, but one day it started to get a little bit empty.
Mum and Dad added lots of food to the fridge, but still it was not full. So the family decided to add more food.
The family reached out for help from their neighbours and friends. Everyone added something special to the fridge. Before long, the fridge was full up again with lots of yummy food.
The family were so happy that they could fill the fridge again. They were thankful for all the help they got, and felt less helpless now that the fridge was full.
The End.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was an elderly man who was sitting on the park bench. He was eating some butter on his toast and humming to himself.
Just then a little 3 year old boy came running up to him. He looked up at the elderly man with his big brown eyes and said, "What are you doing, Mister?"
The elderly man smiled and said, "I'm just enjoying my toast with some butter. Would you like some?"
The little boy shook his head and said, "No, thank you. But can you show me something?"
The elderly man looked around and said, "What would you like to see?"
The little boy pointed to the trees and said, "Can you show me how to listen to the trees?"
The elderly man's eyes twinkled and he said, "Yes, of course! Just close your eyes and listen. Can you hear the birds singing in the distance? The wind rustling through the leaves?"
The little boy's face lit up with excitement and he began to listen. Soon he heard the birds singing and the leaves rustling, and he smiled.

The elderly man smiled too, glad that he was able to show the little boy something new and interesting. He watched on as the little boy listened to the sounds of nature, and thought of all the things he could show him in the future.

chapters.title: Bopus and his mum were at…
p: Bopus and his mum were at the airport. Bopus wanted to travel to a different city. His mum gave him a passport. Bopus felt very excited!
The passport officer looked at Bopus' passport and said, "Hmm, this record isn't good enough!" Bopus was surprised. His mum got very angry and said, "What do you mean?"
The passport officer said, "This passport has been used too much. You need to get a new passport before we can let you go."
Mum was very ashamed. She said, "I'm sorry Bopus. We can't go this time." Bopus was so sad. He wanted to cry, but he didn't.
They had to go home. Bopus knew Mum was disappointed, but he couldn't do anything about it. He didn't want to make her feel even more ashamed.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl named Samantha. She was 3 years old and she loved color. Everywhere she went, she looked for the pretty, colorful things she saw. One day, Samantha was in her bedroom, looking for something colorful. On the nightstand, she saw a glass cup. She picked it up and looked at it.
The glass cup was so colorful. She twirled it around in her hands and smiled. Suddenly, the cup slipped and broke into many pieces. Samantha was sad.
Her mom came in and comforted her. She said, "It's okay, Samantha. Accidents happen. But we have to always be careful and not break beautiful things."

Samantha nodded and wiped away her tears. She looked around the room and saw the rainbow of colors. She smiled and decided to look for colorful things, but carefully. She learned that it is important to respect and take care of things that are beautiful.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a fat cat named Fluffy. Every day Fluffy would look through a big dictionary she had given to her 3 years ago. Every day she would learn new words from it. She loved to learn new things.
One day Fluffy decided to go for a walk. She was walking and walking and then noticed a tree in the distance. Fluffy wanted to take a closer look so she started to walk towards it.
Suddenly, Fluffy realised she had left her dictionary at home. She quickly turned around and started to run back home. When she arrived, she noticed her dictionary was missing!
Fluffy quickly spoke to her owner, "I miss my dictionary", she said sadly. Her owner said, "Do not worry Fluffy, I will help you find it."
Fluffy started to look everywhere for her dictionary: she looked under the bed, in the cupboard and even in the garden. After a long search, Fluffy finally found her dictionary in the kitchen.
Fluffy happily hugged her dictionary and said, "I missed you so much!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a smart rabbit named Harry. Harry had a big, fluffy patch of fur on his back that shined like the stars.
One day, Harry hopped around in the forest and saw a bear. The bear said to him, "Why don't you come to my house? We can play together!"
Harry was a bit worried, but he wanted to be brave, so he went with the bear.
The bear showed Harry around his house. Harry saw lots of fun things like books, toys, and tasty food.
The bear said, "Let's spend the night here!"
Harry didn't want to spend the night, but the bear was so eager, he couldn't say no.
Harry stayed awake all night, feeling scared and nervous. In the morning, the bear asked Harry to stay longer, but Harry said no. He was very smart and knew it was time to go home.
Harry hopped away and never went back to the bear's house. Instead, he continued spending his time in the forest, looking for more fun adventures.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a girl named Stacy. She had a clean pink dress and wanted to go out and play. But when she asked her mom, her mom said no.
Stacy got a little mad and started to demand to go out. "Why can't I go out and play?" she asked.
Her mom said, "No, it's getting dark and it's not safe. We'll go out tomorrow when the sun is up."
But Stacy didn't like that answer. She really wanted to go out. She started to cry and said, "Please Mommy!"
Her mom felt bad and decided to tell her a story. "Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Stacy," she said.
Stacy listened closely as her mom told her the story. It was about a girl who kept having nightmares. She was so scared that she didn't leave her house for days.
Suddenly, the girl had an idea. She gathered up all her courage and decided to go outside, even though it was dark. To her surprise, all the monsters in the night weren't as scary as she thought.
Stacy smiled and said, "So there's no need to be scared. We can go out for a bit, can't we?"
Her mom smiled back and said, "Yes, of course. As long as we stay in the clean and safe places,

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a lady. She was a very noisy lady. Everywhere she went, it was noisy.
The lady wanted to be quiet. But every time she tried, something noisy happened.
One day the noisy lady found a place that was very quiet. It was a very quiet spot, but it was hidden away.
She went to the quiet spot everyday and wanted to stay there. It was her happy place.
But one day, the lady couldn't find the quiet spot. It was gone! She was so sad and looked everywhere, but it was no use.
The lady was sad, but she kept trying to find the quiet spot. She knew it was somewhere special.

chapters.title: One day Jack was playing in…
p: One day, Jack was playing in his garden. He was wearing his favourite shirt and shorts. Suddenly, Jack spotted something very expensive in the garden. It was a shiny new dress. “Wow,” said Jack. “This dress is so pretty. I want to wear it!”
So Jack grabbed the dress, and put it on. He looked in the mirror, and he felt like a prince. He even jumped and spun around, showing his new dress to the birds and bees.
Just then, Jack heard his mum calling for him. He quickly ran inside the house and showed his mum the dress.
“Where did you get this?” asked his mum.
“I found it in my garden,” replied Jack, with a big smile.
Mum smiled too. “Well, it looks like you found a very special dress. You should take very good care of it!”
So Jack carefully hung the dress up in his wardrobe, and knew he would look very special the next time he wore it.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a creature who loved insects. His name was Billy. Every day, he would spend some of his time looking for them.
One day, he found an insect that was really delicious. It was little and orange. Billy was so excited to try this new discovery!
He carefully pinched the insect with two fingers. He could not wait to taste it. It was crunchy and sweet.
"Mmmm, this is delicious!" exclaimed Billy.
He took a few more bites until there was nothing left. Billy was very happy that he found his tasty treat. It would be something to remember forever.

chapters.title: One day Sarah saw something special…
p: One day, Sarah saw something special. She saw her friends wearing uniforms. She wanted one too! She asked her mother for one, but her mother said it was too expensive. Sarah was sad.
To cheer her up, her mother suggested that they make their own uniform. Sarah was so excited! She ran to her room to get her craft materials.
They cut and spread the pieces of cloth. Then they used a needle and thread to make the uniform. Sarah could hardly believe it! Her very own yummy uniform was finished.
The next day, Sarah wore her uniform to her friends' house. She showed them her new outfit. They were so jealous! But they were also a bit worried.
"Teacher will see you!", they said. Sarah was worried too. "I wouldn't want to get in trouble. What should I do?", she thought.
Then she had an idea! She ran home and grabbed her mother's fabric paint. She quickly spread it all over her uniform and now it looked totally different.
Now Sarah could wear her unique uniform with pride! Her friends were so impressed by her creativity. They all wanted their own yummy uniforms now. In the end, everyone was happy!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a fun uncle. His name was Sam. He loved to pretend. One day he asked his niece if she wanted to play. She said yes!
They pretended they were pirates. Sam used a big blanket to make a boat. They sailed around the living room and found amazing treasure. They sang songs and had lots of fun.
Sam was very silly. He made funny noises and faces. His niece giggled and couldn't stop laughing. They had the best time.
When their adventure was over, Sam gave her a hug and said goodbye. His niece still thinks of him and remembers all the fun they had pretending together.
